records.reference_a: ADR-023 §8.64.7 PROPOSED CONSOLIDATED CHECKLIST — NOT OWNER-APPROVED
records.exact_relevant_text_a: Until an owner decision confirms the list and these conditions, the earlier criteria … remain applicable together with this list, and none of them is treated as superseded.
records.exact_relevant_text_b: Earlier mandatory acceptance/closure conditions for Phase 1 and IC.
records.approval_status_a: PROPOSED — NOT OWNER-APPROVED (also OD-CL: retain unconfirmed)
records.approval_status_b: Recorded earlier ADR requirements; remain applicable
records.scope_b: Earlier Phase 1 acceptance, IC closure, decision package, leave-BLOCKED conditions
records.nature_of_conflict: Potential silent replacement of earlier mandatory wording (especially §8.24.9 item 7 full SQLite+PG vs EXIT-09 persistence/concurrency narrowing)
records.technical_impact: If §8.64.7 were treated as sole authority, earlier mandatory tests/IC conditions could be weakened incorrectly
available_interpretations: Treat §8.64.7 as sole checklist (REJECTED — contradicts its own confirmation status and OD-CL)
Treat earlier lists alone and ignore §8.64.7 (INCOMPLETE — loses useful EXIT IDs)
Apply both: earlier lists remain mandatory; §8.64.7 used as organizing EXIT IDs without supersession (SELECTED)
records.final_resolution: SELECTED: dual-applicability model. §8.64.7 organizes EXIT IDs; earlier mandatory requirements remain ACTIVE. Where EXIT-09 wording is narrower than §8.24.9 item 7, both apply until owner confirms §8.64.7.
